overview.text: Hernandez backed a bill that passed the House to expand Latin American history instruction for public school students starting in the 2027-2028 school year. Her caucus page says 2026 laws she backed let people sending money abroad donate to the Illinois DREAM Fund, created a cosmetology apprenticeship program and require grocery chains with e-coupons to offer paper ones. In 2019, she co-sponsored a bill to ban for-profit immigrant detention centers in Illinois, stating they lacked oversight and specialized care.
